Carousel

Carousel cycles through a set of slides with navigation controls, indicators, auto-play, and various transition styles.

A simple carousel with one active slide visible at a time.

JavaScript

Full carousel navigation implementation.

JS
function initCarousel(containerId, slideId) {
    const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
    const slides    = document.getElementById(slideId);
    const total     = slides.children.length;
    let current     = 0;

    function goTo(index) {
        current = (index + total) % total;
        slides.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + (current * 100) + '%)';
    }

    container.querySelector('.zak-carousel-prev')?.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(current - 1));
    container.querySelector('.zak-carousel-next')?.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(current + 1));

    const interval = parseInt(container.dataset.zakAutoplay);
    if (interval) {
        let timer = setInterval(() => goTo(current + 1), interval);
        container.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => clearInterval(timer));
        container.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
            timer = setInterval(() => goTo(current + 1), interval);
        });
    }
}

initCarousel('basicCarousel', 'basicSlides');

Accessibility

  • Prev/Next buttons require aria-label describing their action.
  • Indicators must have aria-label and the active one should use aria-current="true".
  • Use aria-live="polite" on the slides container so screen readers announce slide changes.
  • Carousel must pause on hover and when keyboard-focused; respect prefers-reduced-motion by disabling auto-play.
  • Each slide should contain meaningful content with heading structure appropriate for the content.
